title: A prepaid card must remain rechargeable inside the device
body_md: If a prepaid card is used, it must be possible to top up the credit without removing the card from the device, for example from another mobile phone.
source_region: Section 2.1, closing sentence of the red box
prev_context: Before this stands the card recommendation that differs between versions.
next_context: The four-step preparation of the card follows.
change_reason: Extracted from the English source page itself, not translated from the German master, and cross-read against the German page 13: the prepaid condition is equivalent in substance and is the only undisputed part of the box; it is therefore kept separate from the disputed part.
